query.description: E-Test 파일 헤더 생성 - 파일명 8칸 규칙 (2026-10-12 PARSE_RULE_VER 2: Customer / File Device / Wafer Type / Wafer Rev / Lot-Wafer No / Fab, FILE_PREFIX 는 채우지 않음, VIEW_SIDE BACK)
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE (SRC_FILE_SEQ, FILE_NAME, FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, LOT_ID, SLOT_NO, TEST_PROGRAM, TEST_TIME, SHEET_NAME, DIE_COUNT, ITEM_COUNT, CUSTOMER, FILE_DEVICE, WAFER_TYPE, WAFER_REV, LOT_WAFER_NO, FAB_NAME, PARSE_RULE_VER, VIEW_SIDE, LOAD_STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (:src_file_seq, :file_name, :factory, :device_id, :lot_id, :slot_no, :test_program, TO_DATE(:test_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), :sheet_name, :die_count, :item_count, :customer, :file_device, :wafer_type, :wafer_rev, :lot_wafer_no, :fab_name, 2, 'BACK', 'LOADING', :create_user, SYSDATE, :update_user, SYSDATE)

SELECT SRC_FILE_SEQ, FILE_NAME, FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, LOT_ID, SLOT_NO, WAFER_ID, TEST_PROGRAM, TO_CHAR(TEST_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS TEST_TIME, FILE_PREFIX, SHEET_NAME, DIE_COUNT, ITEM_COUNT, VALUE_COUNT, LOAD_STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, CUSTOMER, FILE_DEVICE, WAFER_TYPE, WAFER_REV, LOT_WAFER_NO, FAB_NAME, PASS_DIE_COUNT, FAIL_DIE_COUNT, NOT_TESTED_COUNT, PARSE_RULE_VER, VIEW_SIDE, HEADER_COUNT, DEFINED_COUNT, MISSING_COUNT, JUDGE_TIME, MAP_ID, MAP_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE WHERE SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq

query.description: (이전 키, 2026-10-07 13:13 이전 배포 BSL 호환용으로만 남김) 같은 시험 파일 존재 확인 (Factory / Device / Lot / Slot / 시험 프로그램 / 시험 일시)
query.commandtext: SELECT SRC_FILE_SEQ, FILE_NAME, WAFER_ID, LOAD_STATUS, DIE_COUNT, ITEM_COUNT, VALUE_COUNT, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND LOT_ID = :lot_id AND SLOT_NO = :slot_no AND TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program AND TEST_TIME = TO_DATE(:test_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')

query.description: 같은 Wafer 파일 존재 확인 (UNIQUE 키: Factory / WAFER_ID = Lot + '-' + 2자리 Slot. 2026-10-07 기준 Device / 시험 일시는 키에서 제외)
query.commandtext: SELECT SRC_FILE_SEQ, FILE_NAME, DEVICE_ID, WAFER_ID, TEST_PROGRAM, TO_CHAR(TEST_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS TEST_TIME, LOAD_STATUS, DIE_COUNT, ITEM_COUNT, VALUE_COUNT, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND WAFER_ID = :wafer_id

query.description: 같은 Wafer + 같은 공정 파일 존재 확인 (UNIQUE 키: Factory / WAFER_ID / TEST_PROGRAM = 공정 TSVET·COWET·FT, 2026-10-12)
query.commandtext: SELECT SRC_FILE_SEQ, FILE_NAME, DEVICE_ID, WAFER_ID, TEST_PROGRAM, TO_CHAR(TEST_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS TEST_TIME, LOAD_STATUS, DIE_COUNT, ITEM_COUNT, VALUE_COUNT, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program

query.description: Device 의 E-Test 파일 목록 (최근 시험 순)
query.commandtext: SELECT F.SRC_FILE_SEQ, F.FILE_NAME, F.LOT_ID, F.SLOT_NO, F.WAFER_ID, F.TEST_PROGRAM, TO_CHAR(F.TEST_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS TEST_TIME, F.CUSTOMER, F.FILE_DEVICE, F.WAFER_TYPE, F.WAFER_REV, F.LOT_WAFER_NO, F.DIE_COUNT, F.PASS_DIE_COUNT, F.FAIL_DIE_COUNT, F.HEADER_COUNT, F.DEFINED_COUNT, F.ITEM_COUNT, F.MISSING_COUNT, F.VALUE_COUNT, F.NOT_TESTED_COUNT, F.MAP_ID, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TQP_GDS_ET_DIE D WHERE D.SRC_FILE_SEQ = F.SRC_FILE_SEQ AND D.MAP_X IS NOT NULL) AS MAP_DIE_COUNT, F.JUDGE_TIME, F.MAP_TIME, F.PARSE_RULE_VER, F.LOAD_STATUS, F.CREATE_USER, F.CREATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE F WHERE F.FACTORY = :factory AND F.DEVICE_ID = :device_id ORDER BY F.TEST_TIME DESC, F.SRC_FILE_SEQ DESC

query.description: 저장 확정: 건수 확인 후 LOADING -> READY
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE SET LOAD_STATUS = 'READY', VALUE_COUNT = :value_count, UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq AND LOAD_STATUS = 'LOADING'

query.description: 저장 확정: 건수 확인 후 LOADING -> READY + 파일 요약 (Pass / Fail Die 수, 미측정 셀 수, 2026-10-12)
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE SET LOAD_STATUS = 'READY', VALUE_COUNT = :value_count, PASS_DIE_COUNT = :pass_die_count, FAIL_DIE_COUNT = :fail_die_count, NOT_TESTED_COUNT = :not_tested_count, UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq AND LOAD_STATUS = 'LOADING'

query.description: 파일 헤더 삭제 (Die / 측정값은 BSL 이 먼저 지운다)
E-Test 파일 헤더 생성 - 등록 Parameter 만 저장 (2026-10-14 PARSE_RULE_VER 3: Fab / 면은 저장하지 않음, 헤더 / 등록 / 누락 수)
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE (SRC_FILE_SEQ, FILE_NAME, FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, LOT_ID, SLOT_NO, TEST_PROGRAM, TEST_TIME, SHEET_NAME, DIE_COUNT, ITEM_COUNT, CUSTOMER, FILE_DEVICE, WAFER_TYPE, WAFER_REV, LOT_WAFER_NO, HEADER_COUNT, DEFINED_COUNT, MISSING_COUNT, FAB_NAME, VIEW_SIDE, PARSE_RULE_VER, LOAD_STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (:src_file_seq, :file_name, :factory, :device_id, :lot_id, :slot_no, :test_program, TO_DATE(:test_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), :sheet_name, :die_count, :item_count, :customer, :file_device, :wafer_type, :wafer_rev, :lot_wafer_no, :header_count, :defined_count, :missing_count, NULL, NULL, 3, 'LOADING', :create_user, SYSDATE, :update_user, SYSDATE)

query.description: 파일 판정 요약: Spec 판정 Pass / Fail Die 수 + '-' 값 수 + 판정 시각 (Die 판정 뒤, 업로드 확정 / 다시 판정 공용)
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE F SET (PASS_DIE_COUNT, FAIL_DIE_COUNT, NOT_TESTED_COUNT) = (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN D.JUDGE_FLAG = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN D.JUDGE_FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), NVL(SUM(D.NOT_TESTED_COUNT), 0) FROM TQP_GDS_ET_DIE D WHERE D.SRC_FILE_SEQ = F.SRC_FILE_SEQ), JUDGE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE F.SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq

query.description: 파일 Map 좌표 계산 기록: 쓴 Map ID(없으면 NULL) / 계산 시각
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE SET MAP_ID = :map_id, MAP_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq

query.description: E-Test 결과 조회 화면 파일 목록 (2026-10-15): Device + 공정(빈 값 = 전체) + Lot 글자(빈 값 = 전체). 추가 Para = 지금 등록 Parameter(사용 Y) 중 업로드 뒤 등록 / 변경되었고 이 파일에 저장 안 된 수(업로드 때 이미 파일에 없던 누락은 빼려고 시각 비교), Spec 바뀜 = 판정 뒤 Spec 수정
query.commandtext: SELECT F.SRC_FILE_SEQ, F.WAFER_ID, F.LOT_ID, F.SLOT_NO, F.TEST_PROGRAM, TO_CHAR(F.TEST_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS TEST_TIME, F.DEVICE_ID, F.DIE_COUNT, F.PASS_DIE_COUNT, F.FAIL_DIE_COUNT, F.ITEM_COUNT, F.VALUE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I WHERE I.FACTORY = F.FACTORY AND I.DEVICE_ID = F.DEVICE_ID AND I.TEST_PROGRAM = F.TEST_PROGRAM AND I.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND NVL(I.UPDATE_TIME, I.CREATE_TIME) > F.CREATE_TIME AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V WHERE V.SRC_FILE_SEQ = F.SRC_FILE_SEQ AND V.ET_ITEM_SEQ = I.ET_ITEM_SEQ)) AS ADDED_PARA_COUNT, CASE WHEN F.JUDGE_TIME IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT L WHERE L.FACTORY = F.FACTORY AND L.DEVICE_ID = F.DEVICE_ID AND L.TEST_PROGRAM = F.TEST_PROGRAM AND NVL(L.UPDATE_TIME, L.CREATE_TIME) > F.JUDGE_TIME) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SPEC_CHANGED, F.MAP_ID, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TQP_GDS_ET_DIE D WHERE D.SRC_FILE_SEQ = F.SRC_FILE_SEQ AND D.MAP_X IS NOT NULL) AS MAP_DIE_COUNT, F.JUDGE_TIME, F.YMS_STATUS, F.YMS_TIME, F.YMS_MESSAGE, F.LOAD_STATUS, F.CREATE_USER, F.CREATE_TIME, F.FILE_NAME FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE F WHERE F.FACTORY = :factory AND F.DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND (:p1 IS NULL OR F.TEST_PROGRAM = :p2) AND (:l1 IS NULL OR UPPER(F.LOT_ID) LIKE '%' || :l2 || '%') ORDER BY F.TEST_TIME DESC, F.SRC_FILE_SEQ DESC

query.description: 연관 분석 Ready: 같은 Wafer 후보 E-Test 파일 (Lot 글자 / Slot, 저장 완료만)
query.commandtext: SELECT F.SRC_FILE_SEQ, F.FACTORY, F.WAFER_ID, F.LOT_ID, F.SLOT_NO, F.LOT_WAFER_NO, F.DEVICE_ID, F.TEST_PROGRAM, TO_CHAR(F.TEST_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TEST_TIME, F.DIE_COUNT, F.PASS_DIE_COUNT, F.FAIL_DIE_COUNT, TO_CHAR(F.JUDGE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS JUDGE_TIME, F.MAP_ID, CASE WHEN F.JUDGE_TIME IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT L WHERE L.FACTORY = F.FACTORY AND L.DEVICE_ID = F.DEVICE_ID AND L.TEST_PROGRAM = F.TEST_PROGRAM AND NVL(L.UPDATE_TIME, L.CREATE_TIME) > F.JUDGE_TIME) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SPEC_CHANGED FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE F WHERE F.FACTORY = :factory AND UPPER(F.LOT_ID) LIKE :lot_like AND F.SLOT_NO = :slot_no AND F.LOAD_STATUS = 'READY' ORDER BY F.TEST_TIME DESC, F.SRC_FILE_SEQ DESC

query.description: 연관 분석: E-Test 파일 1건 + Spec 바뀜
query.commandtext: SELECT F.SRC_FILE_SEQ, F.FACTORY, F.WAFER_ID, F.LOT_ID, F.SLOT_NO, F.LOT_WAFER_NO, F.DEVICE_ID, F.TEST_PROGRAM, TO_CHAR(F.TEST_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TEST_TIME, F.DIE_COUNT, F.PASS_DIE_COUNT, F.FAIL_DIE_COUNT, TO_CHAR(F.JUDGE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS JUDGE_TIME, F.MAP_ID, F.LOAD_STATUS, CASE WHEN F.JUDGE_TIME IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT L WHERE L.FACTORY = F.FACTORY AND L.DEVICE_ID = F.DEVICE_ID AND L.TEST_PROGRAM = F.TEST_PROGRAM AND NVL(L.UPDATE_TIME, L.CREATE_TIME) > F.JUDGE_TIME) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SPEC_CHANGED FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE F WHERE F.SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq
